attach.why: Kept despite its DUPLICATE flag against cfb.player_participation_hazard, which is a position-level game-by-game participation chain with no replacement-quality output: this input alone supplies the quarterback-specific miss-rate covariates (designed rushes, prior injury flag) and the backup rating (shrunk, k=100 dropbacks) that stage s2 and the [qb_availability_hazard x rating_posterior_draws x sp_plus] interaction turn into a mixture over games missed inside the team-rating draws. cfb.player_participation_hazard is deliberately not attached here because no season_futures series is a named-player counting market.

Each of the seven series is defined by its own rules text (settlement_contract coverage and the contract_review): turnovers gained exclude turnovers on downs, statistics on 2-point attempts are excluded, overtime periods one and two count for the interception, sack and turnover series, KXNCAAF2PT counts regulation conversions only, KXNCAAFDELAY counts any official weather delay and non-weather delays resolve No; also in the game_event blueprint, carried explicitly so the archetype's own list supplies what its coverage cites.
